blocks.text: POND’S brought its Fresh Glow Find: POND’S Ukay Takeover to Y2K Vintage Co. along N. Escario St. in Cebu City on October 17, 2026, turning the vintage store into an interactive skincare destination. The activation connected Cebu’s thrift-shopping culture with the discovery of affordable skincare products, allowing visitors to explore POND’S sachet variants while joining activities alongside their search for clothes and accessories. Bringing skincare discovery into Cebu’s ukay-ukay culture The decision to stage the activation in a vintage store was rooted in Cebu’s thrift-shopping culture.
